title: Emotional regulation
learning_outcomes: Explain triggers and appraisals in the context of emotional regulation.
Compare and distinguish alternative interpretations in the context of emotional regulation.
Apply regulation strategies in the context of emotional regulation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about constructive responses in the context of emotional regulation.

lessons.title: Triggers and appraisals
lessons.outcome: Explain triggers and appraisals in the context of emotional regulation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving triggers and appraisals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain triggers and appraisals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of triggers and appraisals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Alternative interpretations
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish alternative interpretations in the context of emotional regulation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving alternative interpretations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain alternative interpretations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of alternative interpretations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Regulation strategies
lessons.outcome: Apply regulation strategies in the context of emotional regulation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving regulation strategies; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain regulation strategies from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of regulation strategies; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Constructive responses
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about constructive responses in the context of emotional regulation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving constructive responses; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain constructive responses from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of constructive responses; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of triggers and appraisals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of alternative interpretations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of regulation strategies; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of constructive responses; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
